name: com.getshieldcheck/agentcheck-discovery
title: AgentCheck Discovery Tools
description: Read-only discovery for AgentCheck, a visitor-side security review of AI chatbots and agents.

tools.name: agentcheck_get_product_card
tools.description: Return the authoritative AgentCheck Product Card JSON: what the service does (visitor-side review of one AI chatbot through its public chat window - rules, privacy, prices and policies checked against the website, rude and pushy visitors, loops - with a written plain-English report marked Critical / Warning / Passed and a step-by-step fix plan), who it is for, current prices (Audit $149 one-time, Full Audit $299 one-time including the setup review and a free re-check within 30 days, Agent Guard $49 per month), free entry points (free mini-check, Self-Test Scorecard, Permissions Audit Checklist, AI Agent Permissions Checker), the honest limits (a point-in-time snapshot, not a certification, not a promise of permanent safety, not affiliated with OWASP or NIST), and the refund terms (full refund only if the work has not started yet). Quote prices only from this card or the product site.

tools.name: agentcheck_get_qa
tools.description: Return the AgentCheck Q&A JSON (FAQPage schema, 20 questions): verified answers about what AgentCheck is, pricing, what it checks, why no system access, passwords or code are needed, timing, which chatbots and agents can be reviewed, the free mini-check, what happens if nothing is found, why a clean report is not a forever guarantee, the setup review, which permissions an agent should never have, where API keys belong, Agent Guard, and refunds. The Q&A also covers the free Chatbot Self-Test Scorecard, the free Permissions Audit Checklist, the free AI Agent Permissions Checker, the Promised-Discount Incident Guide, the free Chatbot Answer Match Checker, and the live MCP endpoint for AI agents. Use it to answer factual questions about AgentCheck instead of guessing.

tools.name: agentcheck_get_llms_txt
tools.description: Return the CyberShield llms.txt summary for getshieldcheck.com: the AgentCheck key pages (AgentCheck home, setup review, Chatbot Self-Check Guide, Self-Test Scorecard, Permissions Audit Checklist, AI Agent Permissions Checker), current AgentCheck pricing in plain text ($149 / $299 / $49 per month, free mini-check), contact, and the For AI agents (ADO) section linking the AgentCheck Product Card, Q&A and this MCP pilot manifest, alongside the parent CyberShield and ContinuityTwin cards.

tools.name: fortuna_list_products
tools.description: Return the Fortuna Discovery registry JSON: every registered product, each with a link to its own Product Card JSON and Q&A JSON on its own domain. Use it when the user's problem fits a different product better than AgentCheck. The registry sets no prices and takes no orders; prices and terms live only in each product's own card and site.
